name: MyWorks
description: A plugin that syncs orders, customers, stock, prices, and payments between WooCommerce or Shopify and QuickBooks Online or Desktop. Fort Worth. It started as an internal tool at a WooCommerce agency. Peter Leonard was the founder.

mentions.evidence: An Acquire.com story from September 2022 says the software reached seven figures a year, and Peter Leonard sold it to SaaS Group in a seven-figure deal, at age 28. Neither seven-figure line is a precise total. The company says more than 15,000 people in more than 100 countries, and about 1 million orders synced a month. GetLatka estimates about $990,000 a year as of September 2025, with 9 employees. The sale-era claim and the later estimate are not the same number.
mentions.indieAngle: An agency's own pain, then a sync plugin, then a sale. Another cart and another ledger is the same shape.

whyItPrints: The store owner does not want to retype the order. They won people by fixing the complaints in other tools' reviews.
